about: a switch is a 2 px capsule at the right edge, centred, at most 34 tall and 2 * height - 4 wide, with an 8 px margin when wider than 32; on fills it with a paper circle on the right, off leaves it hollow with an ink circle on the left; the text runs to 12 px before the capsule (none when no room is left) and is bold from 2.16; a note splits the height into two halves 2 px clear of the middle; a non-string note is invalid (probe-confirmed)
